goal: Make every Harness task plan-driven, event-backed, replayable, and settlement-gated without replacing the existing task state machine or adding new database services.

acceptance_criteria.description: Harness task creation records a loop_plan_created event, and loop action/observation/decision events use the stable MVP payload shape.
Harness completion is settlement-gated: completed tasks require non-empty evidence and terminal tasks reject additional loop action events.
Harness sensor settlement records loop observations, blocks insufficient-material tasks with blocking_reason, and routes review-required-by-default tasks to review_required instead of completed.
Dashboard APIs expose Harness task lists and chronological task timelines from the existing harness_task_events store.
The deterministic Loop Engineering MVP evaluator is included in the targeted agent check profile.
